flags: PRICE: the operator's site posts no rate and there is no booking engine; call 330-525-7054. Camper figures only: RV Life review June 2023 '$35 USD a night' on back-in site 87 (before the 2024 date bar), Campendium $40 undated, RV Life avg_rate $35, tier $$. Fees left unset. Nothing suggests it nears $50. No Good Sam Park (directory gs=False).
PRESENCE: passes. Working Wix site with phone; Google 4.4 over 125 reviews, open, 330-525-7054. Review text wasn't read beyond RV Life's one favourable 2023 review.

LONG-STAY LEAD (test 2 / test 4): the operator leads with 'SEASONAL SITES ARE AVAILABLE! SEASONAL - MONTHLY - WEEKLY - OVERNIGHT - FULL HOOKUP - PRIMITIVE'. Overnight is sold, but no nightly rate is posted and the seasonal share isn't stated. Imagery shows tightly packed lots ringing the ponds, which reads as mostly seasonal, though a 2023 camper paid nightly on lot 87 on the pond ring. The '~$40' in the old note rested on nothing the operator posts, so it was dropped. A phone call would settle the share.

WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (downward): stored lakefront rests on the operator's 'five acre, well stocked fishing lake, spring fed'. Esri imagery shows two joined ponds, about 135 x 90 m (~2.5 acres) and about 70 m across, smaller than the claim even together; a 2023 camper calls it 'a pond/ lake area (catch and release only)'. The numbered lots do ring the water, so pond looks right rather than not waterfront. The map's label is 'LAKE TIMASHAMIE'.
Town on the stored entry: Google and the operator give 28251 Georgetown Rd, Salem, OH 44460. Pin is at the office/pool, ~170 m north of the centre of the lots: fine.
The operator map labels the west stream the 'Mahoning River' while its page says 'A beautiful creek running through the property': not plotted, no field depends on it.
